description: This bar chart, titled "VisuoThink Empowering LVLM Reasoning with Multimodal Tree Search," illustrates the performance gain in percentage points for two distinct supervision conditions—"Strong Supervision" (represented by blue bars with diagonal stripes) and "Weak Supervision" (represented by solid light blue bars)—across two different large vision-language models: "Claude-3.5-Sonnet" and "Qwen2-72B-VL." The vertical axis, labeled "Performance Gain (%)," is scaled linearly from 0 to 30, with major gridlines and tick marks at intervals of 5 percentage points. The horizontal axis lists the two model names. For the "Claude-3.5-Sonnet" model, the "Strong Supervision" bar reaches approximately 24.5% performance gain, while the "Weak Supervision" bar is significantly lower at approximately 5.2%. For the "Qwen2-72B-VL" model, the "Strong Supervision" bar indicates a performance gain of approximately 15%, and the "Weak Supervision" bar corresponds to approximately 5.5%. The bars are grouped side-by-side for each model, with the "Strong Supervision" bar consistently taller than its "Weak Supervision" counterpart. The chart does not appear to sort the bars by height or any other criterion; both model categories are presented in the order listed on the x-axis. The legend in the top-left corner explicitly maps the striped pattern to "Strong Supervision" and the solid color to "Weak Supervision." There are no visual emphasis techniques such as shading, bolding, or annotations applied to any of the bars.
